title: TASE: Token Awareness and Structured Evaluation for Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on fine-grained token-level awareness and structural understanding tasks across three typologically diverse languages (English, Chinese, and Korean). The study computes language-specific advantage metrics (English Advantage, Chinese Advantage, and Korean Advantage) and analyzes the cross-lingual standard deviation of accuracy to quantify systemic bias favoring English.
